$comment: Copyright 2026 sinkerine. SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-Element-Commercial. Client cap 60000 UTF-8 JSON bytes; producer cap 40000. Relational constraints and error precedence are specified in fixtures/README.md.

state.description: Initial state. Semantic validation uses only reachable bindings: strings default to 200 characters; a retained text_input permits its max_length up to 2000. Shared input bindings must satisfy every bound limit.

chart.description: At most 800 finite numeric values across series. Scatter counts both x and y (400 points total). Categorical values arrays must match categories length. These cross-array constraints require semantic validation.
